result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 2 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x)
    sc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    other=next(x for x in cnt if x!=sc)
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==sc]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    # unit block size is the common side of the scaffold tiles
    unit=4
    occ=set()
    for r,c in pts:
        occ.add(((r-r0)//unit,(c-c0)//unit))
    R=max(r for r,c in occ)+1; C=max(c for r,c in occ)+1
    return [[other if (r,c) in occ else 0 for c in range(C)] for r in range(R)]"}
